scope: Read-only review of Phase25 actual business browser, business TLS routing listener, and Phase25 execution hooks; no dynamic service or database execution.

findings.requestedFix: Pass a stable valid explicit idempotency key; validate the same request/key recovers the same ticket without another write.
findings.problem: Actual ticket creation omits the mandatory Idempotency-Key header. The current work-orders route rejects it before writing, so the real write/durable-result case cannot pass.
findings.evidence: saas-work-orders/backend/src/http.rs:264-268 requires one nonempty idempotency-key header; json() currently exposes no option for it.

findings.requestedFix: Perform readiness as a same-origin browser navigation/read, then return to Console before socket requests so the exact allowed Origin remains intact; or use an explicitly declared owner readiness probe.
findings.problem: Notification readiness is fetched from another port in the browser, but the health response has no CORS header. A valid healthy response is blocked by Chromium and the notification case fails before connecting.
findings.evidence: saas-notification/src/server.rs:429-550 adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin only to socket paths; the non-socket branch starts at552. The routing gateway does not add CORS.

findings.requestedFix: Check actual context/browser closure; preserve a failed cleanup result and nonzero exit if any remains connected.
findings.problem: The finally block suppresses browser.close failure and then unconditionally reports browserClosed=true, allowing false cleanup success.
findings.evidence: The same block suppresses each context close failure and never verifies browser.isConnected().

limitations: No dynamic PASS or complete cleanup claim is made by this review.
The root owner may update the reviewed files after these recorded hashes; fixes require current-source re-review or dynamic evidence.
